Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body: Does putting Derange on a vampire with Go Anarch burn the Go Anarch?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Jan 13, 5:34 pm, XZealot <xzea...@cox.net> wrote:
> Does putting Derange on a vampire with Go Anarch burn the Go Anarch?

Turning non-Independent burns the card, by card text, yes.

If a vampire changes clans to a clan that belongs to a different sect,
he changes sects as well. [10]

If a anarch convert (which is "independet, anarch" by card text) gets
derange and change clan say Malkavian antitribu, then the convert

Anarch Convert, 1, Caitiff, 0
Independent. Anarch: When the convert enters play, you may remove him
from the game to make a non-titled vampire you control anarch and
either gain 1 pool or draw a card from your crypt.

Derange, Action, Malkavian/Malkavian Antitribu
This is a +1 stealth action. (D) Put this card on a younger vampire.
The vampire with this card is considered to be the same clan as the
acting vampire. The vampire with this card does not untap as normal.
During his or her controller`s untap phase, he or she may burn 1 blood

I think Scott's answer means that, if the Anarch Convert changes clan
when he removes the Derange (which should happen every time he removes
the Derange), the his sect reverts back to its default clan's (*)
sect.

(*) Although Caitiff is not a clan, it's considered to be a Camarilla
bunch of vampires.

Now, here's a funny question:
Suppose Anarch Convert gets Deranged (let's say to Malkavian). He
becomes Camarilla. Suppose then that he changes sect back to
independent, thanks to Fall of the Camarilla. Is the Anarch Convert an
Anarch again ?

You weren't unclear. The rule LSJ quoted applies, no matter what sect
is written on the vampire for the sect that he enters play as.

The same holds true if (for example) Joe "Boot" Hill gets Deranged to
Malk (becoming Cam) and then removes it - he is now an Independent
Assamite because that is the default for his clan, even though
"Sabbat" is printed in his card text.
